source_classification.content: Buildable DAG stages, prerequisite collection bases, branch/commit changes and reading-order descriptions do not by themselves change formatter behavior. Full stack/snapshot table belongs to one evaluation overview.

Old baseline engine, checked configuration, Dragonbox conversion and exact decimal helpers extracted separately before use/migration. Mechanical body proofs are byte comparisons; configuration proof is qualified by recorded EOF newline normalization. Public base migrates only after internal checked features qualify.

Qualified checked engine is split into output accounting, parse/validation, primitives, floating conversion/formatting, extension traits, Unicode, modern/ADL/static formatter protocols, and transport headers. Include composition, helper placement, comments and spelling/layout change; no new numeric-formatting algorithm is intended. OpenMP declare-target wrappers were explicitly retained/restored. Obsolete legacy implementation and unused old UTF-8 helper deletion are separate from migration.

Named/range/chrono/standard/style/printf/enum header C++ tokens and include sets match the qualified source after whitespace/comments/include-order normalization; shared-family lambda rename once→render_and_measure is documented. Required output padding hooks live with shared-family support.

Split mixed omnibus files without dropping original assertions. New direct accounting/parsing/conversion/family/named tests, empty-output oracle helper correction and native-extension unsupported=77 handling are real test changes. Quad oracle extension is now enabled before fmt inclusion only on supported hosts. These are not claimed to be history-only.

Exact eight aeff files restore full-stream comparison, complete fmt oracle strings on all four execution wrappers, runtime null-string rejection, specifier-path subnormal checks and shortest float expectations. Hashes and destination stages are below.

Case registry modules, separate pinned oracle/process/evidence/adapter implementations, typed numeric-memory templates and focused unit tests replace combined scripts. Preserve their actual captured source hashes; this restructuring does not retroactively qualify old hardware evidence against new harness source.

Explicit suite registrations, no silent CMake omissions, installable header-only target, dependency tracking/compiler lookup/backend regression selection, optional extension skips and bounded CI resources are meaningful build changes. Coverage policy deliberately replaces percentage blocking with reporting; readiness-wave gating and sanitizer correction are distinct decisions.

API/backend/build/conformance navigation expanded; campaign material remains in evaluation. Two independent compiler reproducers preserved byte-for-byte in evaluation; their library deletion is a separate decision from obsolete-engine deletion.

source_review_history: The earlier final-source-review.json captured pre-repair 10b1280 and explicitly left restoration/requalification pending. This supplemental audit verifies restored bytes in the frozen release without rewriting that earlier capture.
limitations: Exact byte/fixture comparisons and classified static source review. It does not prove universal semantic equivalence. CPU qualifications name their exact stage commits; historical hardware measurements retain original source hashes and pins.
